statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0, I48.91)
The symptoms are intermittent and must be correlated with rhythm disturbances
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is indicated
The purpose is to optimize rate control and assess for further arrhythmic burden
Diagnosis codes I48.0 and I48.91 were submitted
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
